auth.signInSubtitle: Access the land registry with your account
auth.signUpSubtitle: Register to look up land parcels and their audit trail
auth.usernameHint: 3–32 characters — letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens
auth.citizenOnlyNote: Accounts created here are citizen accounts. Official accounts are issued by the department.

errors.usernameLength: Username must be between 3 and 32 characters.
errors.usernameInvalid: Username may only contain letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

search.title: Search by ULPIN
search.subtitle: Query the world state for an exact Unique Land Parcel Identification Number

owner.title: Search by Owner
owner.subtitle: CouchDB rich query — returns all land assets registered to an Aadhaar ID
owner.noneFound: No land assets found for this owner ID.

register.title: Register Land Parcel
register.subtitle: Submit a new land asset to the Hyperledger Fabric ledger
register.ulpinHint: Unique Land Parcel ID — must not already exist on ledger
register.parentUlpinHint: Leave as NONE for a root (unsplit) parcel
register.docHashHint: SHA-256 hash or IPFS CID of the physical deed document
register.failDefault: Transaction failed. Check Spring Boot logs.

transfer.title: Transfer Ownership
transfer.subtitle: Execute an ownership transfer transaction on the blockchain
transfer.knownIssue: <0>Known Backend Issue:</0> The current backend service passes empty strings for <1>sellerId</1> and <2>newDocumentHash</2> to the chaincode, which validates both as required fields and rejects the transaction. Update <3>LandRegistryService.transferOwnership()</3> to forward these fields. This form sends them ready for when that fix lands.
transfer.ulpinHint: The parcel being transferred — must be ACTIVE
transfer.sellerHint: Must match the currentOwnerId on the ledger
transfer.newDocHashHint: Updated deed document hash after ownership change
transfer.failDefault: Transfer failed. Check Spring Boot logs for details.

mutate.title: Mutate / Split Parcel
mutate.subtitle: Retire a parent parcel and create two child sub-parcels from it
mutate.knownIssue: <0>Known Backend Issue:</0> The backend service currently passes only 5 arguments to the chaincode <1>mutateLand</1> function, which requires 7 (parentUlpin, currentOwnerId, child1Ulpin, child1Gps, child2Ulpin, child2Gps, newDocumentHash). Update <2>LandRegistryService.mutateLand()</2> and the <3>MutateRequest</3> DTO to forward all 7 parameters before using this endpoint.
mutate.parentUlpinHint: Parcel to be split — will be retired as RETIRED_MUTATED
mutate.newDocHashHint: Updated survey deed reflecting the split
mutate.failDefault: Mutation failed. Check Spring Boot logs for details.

history.title: Immutable Audit Trail
history.subtitle: Query the cryptographic ledger history for an asset.
history.failDefault: Failed to fetch audit trail from the blockchain.

map.title: Search by Map
map.subtitle: Click a location to generate its ULPIN and GPS coordinates
map.emptyHint1: Click anywhere on the map to identify a land parcel and generate its ULPIN
map.emptyHint2: ULPIN is derived from reverse-geocoded state and district codes
map.geocodeFailed: Reverse geocoding failed. Check your connection.
map.tapHint: Tap below to open the Register form with ULPIN and GPS pre-filled.
